描述_EN: according to buddhist teachings, a bodhisattva is a deity on the path to reaching enlightenment. sea creatures swarm in the waves foaming over her bare feet. by this period (late ming) guanyin took on the aspect of an elegant lady in flowing robes. this graceful figure has been finely carved from rhinoceros horn and represents the 'compassionate' bodhisattva guanyin, also known as avalokiteshvara. here she is pouring from a bottle the sweet waters of salvation.
描述_ZN: 根据佛教教义，菩萨是通向开悟之路的神灵。 海洋生物蜂拥而至，在她的赤脚上冒着泡沫。 在这一时期（明末）观音菩萨呈现出一个身着飘逸长袍的优雅女士的形象。 这个优雅的形象是由犀牛角精雕细琢而成的，代表了 "慈悲 "的观世音菩萨，也被称为阿瓦洛蒂什瓦拉。 这里她正从瓶子里倒出救赎的甜水。
